name: Neurotex-A
description: Neurotex-A is BioForge Labs' proprietary CNT-SNT hybrid substrate engineered specifically for neural interface construction, combining metallic-chirality single-wall carbon nanotubes with a functionalized synthetic neural tissue coating that prevents glial scarring and promotes stable long-term electrode-neuron contact. Conventional metal electrodes degrade in neural tissue as the brain encapsulates them in scar tissue; Neurotex-A's SNT coating actively signals biocompatibility, allowing the surrounding neurons to treat the electrode as a native structure and even grow toward it. Signal fidelity remains stable over multi-year implant periods that would destroy conventional electrodes.
applications: motor cortex control interfaces for prosthetics
story_hooks: Neurotex-A is the only material that enables stable long-term high-bandwidth neural interfaces — which means BioForge Labs effectively controls who can have the most advanced augmentations, and they know it.

A black-market surgeon is offering Neurotex-A implants at a tenth the market price; the material is genuine, but it's been harvested from explanted augments with unknown histories — and one of those histories involves someone who should be dead.

BioForge Labs has discovered that Neurotex-A electrodes, once fully integrated, can theoretically be used to write as well as read neural signals — they've suppressed the research, but someone leaked it.
